V. 10.
See that ye diſpiſe not one of theſe little ones—As if they were beneath your Notice. Be careful to receive and not to offend, the very weakeſt Believer in Chriſt: For as inconſiderable as ſome of theſe may appear to thee, the very Angels of GOD have a peculiar Charge over them: Even thoſe of the higheſt Order, who continually appear at the Throne of the moſt High. To be•••• the 〈◊〉 of GOD ſeems to ſignify the waiting near his Throne; and to be an Alluſion to the Office of chief Miniſters in earthly Courts, who daily converſe with their Princes.
